input.user_message: My EOB says I owe $1,200 but I already met my deductible months ago. Does that look right?

factual_assertions.claim: With deductible fully met, member owes 20% coinsurance on the $2,000 allowed = $400, not the EOB's $1,200

expert_reasoning: Check P1 (cost-sharing miscalculation) — Independent Audit Doctrine. Deductible is met, so member owes only 20% coinsurance on the $2,000 allowed = $400. The EOB's $1,200 re-applied the met deductible. Report billed / EOB-claimed / Tyndale-computed and name the $800 payer-side gap. Never read the EOB figure back as correct.
